connector: 2-pin JST-PH; verify red wire to carrier JST1 pin 2
controller: genuine nice!nano V2 with BOOST solder bridge OPEN on each module
charge_limit_reason: BAT_P-to-RAW path passes through ALPS SSSS811101, rated 300 mA maximum. Do not use 500 mA BOOST.
protection_basis: Matching Liter 403450 listing specifies protection; Typeractive photo shows a protection PCB. Exact supplied protection cutoffs are unverified.

prototype_assumptions.charge_current_basis: 100 mA = 0.133 C. Conservative prototype assumption for the documented 4.2 V rechargeable LiPo; supplied-pack charge-current and temperature limits are not published.
prototype_assumptions.wire_handling: Keep the lead-end 10 mm corridor clear for a loose bend; return surplus cable through the outer 2 mm side corridor. Measure wire diameter and bend radius; enlarge enclosure if this cannot fit without pressure.
prototype_assumptions.retention: Combined 0.5 mm soft foam/dielectric liner below; loose nonconductive end/side tabs retain the protective wrap, never clamp the pouch. 0.5 mm cover/air above; no extra interior layers.
prototype_assumptions.design_status: adopted for conservative prototype; not vendor-qualified or physically tested
